title: Data Center Technician I
description:
Job Summary

Technicians will work under continued mentorship while taking on increasing responsibility in the field.

title: Structured Cabling Technician I
description:
Job Summary

Working alongside experienced technicians, this role assists with cable installation, pathway construction, telecom room build-outs, equipment mounting, and jobsite support activities.
